seo.title: FlyFrame vs Visafoto: Feature Comparison | FlyFrame
seo.description: A side-by-side look at FlyFrame and Visafoto for passport and visa photos: countries, editing, checks, pricing, privacy and more, based on Visafoto's own public pages.

hero.title: flyFrame vs Visafoto
hero.intro: Compare FlyFrame and Visafoto for passport and visa photos. Explore their features, photo requirements, verification, pricing, and key differences.

hub.blurb: Countries, editing, checks, pricing and privacy, side by side. Based on Visafoto's own public pages.

summary.title: The short version
paragraphs: FlyFrame is planned as a passport and visa photo editor for 100+ countries, built around precise, rule-locked editing, a live camera guide, a free photo checker and a phone handoff.

Visafoto is a live service that processes photos automatically and states a price, a refund promise and a long list of document types. On the pages we read, it describes automatic cropping and a "Fix head tilt" option.

cards.name: FlyFrame
cards.text: Rule-locked crop frame, live camera guide, free checker, desktop-to-phone handoff.

cards.name: Visafoto
cards.text: Automatic processing, a stated price, a full-refund promise and many document types.

items.label: FlyFrame
items.text: Everything in this column is planned, not built. Items marked Planned come from our feature list, and the country count of 100+ is our target. Items still open say To be announced.

items.label: Visafoto
items.text: Only what Visafoto's own public pages state, read on 4 November 2026. Quotes are shown in quotation marks.

items.label: Not stated
items.text: We did not find it on the pages we checked. It does not mean the feature does not exist.

groups.title: Coverage and trust
groups.description: Which documents are covered, and how clearly the rules are sourced.

competitor.text: Many countries, including the US, Canada, UK, India, China, Australia and Saudi Arabia, plus generic 3x4 cm, 35x45 mm and 2x2 inch sizes. The total is not stated. It claims "accurate data about all types of documents worldwide"

rows.feature: Official source and last-checked date on each country page

flyframe.text: Yes, shown on every country page

competitor.text: English, with an "Other languages" link. The list isn't given

groups.title: Editing and precision
groups.description: How much control you have over the crop, and how the tool keeps you inside the rules.

flyframe.text: A drag and zoom crop frame locked to the country's rules. It starts from the best automatic crop, so most users only confirm

competitor.text: Automatic: it will "scale and crop the image to the right dimensions". User-controlled cropping is not stated

flyframe.text: Head top, chin, eye band, centre line and edge margin, drawn from the country's rules
Green when in range, amber near the limit, red outside, with a short message such as "head too small, zoom in a little"
Export is blocked when out of range. Zoom cannot drop the resolution below the minimum. No padding and no rotation. The frame cannot extend beyond the original image
The user can move the head-top and chin markers. The measurement then uses the adjusted position and records that it was manual

competitor.text: Yes: a "Fix head tilt" option in the upload settings

flyframe.text: Will follow the colour each country requires

competitor.text: Keep the original, or choose natural off-white, pure white, two grays, two blues, red or yellow
For paid orders: automatic improvement of "illumination and resolution" and clothing extension

groups.title: Capture and checking
groups.description: Getting the photo in, and finding out whether it will pass before you pay.

flyframe.text: Yes: an on-screen guide, a level indicator, and auto-capture when all checks pass

competitor.text: Users are told to take a photo with a smartphone and upload it
"See the result before you pay". Whether the preview is watermarked is not stated

flyframe.text: Pass or fail report on size, head height, eye line, blur, lighting, shadows, glasses, expression and background. Payment is needed only for the processed file

competitor.text: For its main tool. Its footer links to a "Free Green Card Lottery photo checker", which the page doesn't describe

flyframe.text: A QR code opens the camera on the phone and sends the photo back to the computer session

competitor.text: The page is in English, with an "Other languages" link

groups.title: Pricing and guarantee
groups.description: What you pay, what you get, and what happens if a photo is rejected.

competitor.text: "$9 US dollars for a digital picture that you can use multiple times", per its cheap-passport-photos page. A printout costs extra

flyframe.text: A digital photo, and the print-ready sheet if included

competitor.text: Two versions at once: a digital one and one for 4x6 printing
A testimonial mentions brightness fixes arranged by email

flyframe.text: A print-ready sheet, and printed photos by post if we offer it

competitor.text: Printing at 4x6 inch size through services such as Walgreens, with mailing or pickup. A printout from Visafoto costs extra
"Refund 100% of your money" if a government agency doesn't accept the photo. It cites a "99.7% pass rate" and rejections in "much less than 1% of orders"

groups.title: Account, files and privacy
groups.description: Sign-up, file limits, data handling and support.

competitor.text: "No registration required"
Images and PDFs up to 15 MB each
Adjusted to the required kilobyte size for internet submissions

flyframe.text: A set retention period, with a delete option

competitor.text: Labelled "Secure and private", with a privacy policy. The retention period is not stated
Email described as "24/7 support", plus a chat option

flyframe.heading: FlyFrame, if built as planned
points: Precision editing: a rule-locked crop frame, guide lines, colour feedback and hard limits.
A live camera guide with auto-capture.
A free checker that you can try before you pay.
A phone handoff for people who apply on a laptop.
An official source and date on every country page.

competitor.heading: Visafoto, today
points: It is live and states that it covers many document types.
It states a clear price ($9 per digital photo) and a full-refund promise.
No registration, and uploads of images and PDFs up to 15 MB.
A choice of background colours and a head tilt fix.
It states a 99.7% pass rate. We haven't verified that figure.
